notes:
The natural voices can be heard. Once installed they synthesised the sentence and then played it into an audio channel the system had never started, so the reading could go silent on the first sentence and stay there. The channel is now started before anything is played.

Installing or removing the natural voices no longer empties the voice list. The picker used to vanish from the player, and a reading paused at the time carried on in a system voice instead of the one you chose.
